.²1 Meeting, junction.
.²2 Intimate union, nearness, close contact; {#kimapi kimapi mandaM mandamAsattiyogAt#} <ls>U. 1. 27</ls>.
.²3 Gain, profit, acquirement.
.²4 (In Logic) Proximity, the absence of interruption in the apprehension
 of what is said; relation between two or more proximate terms and the
 sense conveyed by them; {#kAraRaM sanniDAnaM tu padasyAsattirucyate#}
 <ls>Bhāṣā P. 83</ls>; {#vAkyaM syAd yogyatAkANkzAsattiyuktaH padoccayaH#} <ls>S. D. 2</ls>.
.²5 Embarrassment, perplexity; {#na ca te kvacidAsattirbudDeH prAdurBavizyati#} <ls>Mb. 12. 52. 17</ls>.
